page: Microsoft Azure NC144ds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the NCdsRTXPRO6000BSEv6XL family. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor with 144 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 516.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.58 GB of RAM per core.

This instance includes a single GPU and features substantial local storage capacity, consisting of 7921 GB of NVMe SSD storage. It is also capable of utilizing Premium Storage. The high-capacity local NVMe SSD storage provides rapid data access, which is beneficial for workloads requiring large-scale local scratch space or high-throughput data caching.

The hardware profile presents a high density of compute cores and local storage relative to the single GPU configuration. This configuration is designed for workloads that require heavy CPU processing alongside GPU acceleration, such as data science pipelines, machine learning training, and large-scale rendering. The absence of complimentary public IPv4 addresses requires users to configure network routing separately.
